crossRefs.note: Come now therefore, and I will send you to Pharaoh, that you may bring my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.”
Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”
Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”
He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.
He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;

translations.web: “ ‘I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
translations.bsb: Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and afterward I brought you out.
translations.kjv: I sent Moses also and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did among them: and afterward I brought you out.
translations.asv: And I sent Moses and Aaron, and I plagued Egypt, according to that which I did in the midst thereof: and afterward I brought you out.
